title: Microsoft's June 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a record ~200 Windows security flaws, nearly three dozen of them critical, amid growing use of AI to find bugs (Brian Krebs/Krebs on Security)
summary: Brian Krebs / Krebs on Security: Microsoft's June 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a record ~200 Windows security flaws, nearly three dozen of them critical, amid growing use of AI to find bugs — Microsoft today released software updates to plug nearly 200 security holes across its Windows operating systems and supported software …
